_comment: The iTop branches this extension claims to support, and the PHP versions each is
tested on. This file is the single source of truth: the CI matrix is computed from
it, and the supported-versions line of the Hub listing has to agree with it.
A branch names a minor (3.2), never a patch. CI resolves the latest patch of that
branch at run time, so a new 3.2.x published by Combodo is exercised by the next
scheduled run without anyone editing anything - which is the point: the version we
break on is usually the one released after we last looked.
branch           the iTop minor, as it appears in the tag names of Combodo/iTop
php              PHP versions to install that branch on. Two is enough: the floor
and the ceiling of what composer.json allows. The middle version
is covered by the unit matrix in ci.yml.
allow_prerelease resolve to an alpha/beta/rc when the branch has no stable patch
yet. True for a branch we intend to support at its GA and want to
be told about early; never for one users are already running.
pin              an exact tag, when a resolved patch is known broken and the
failure is not ours. Temporary by nature: say why, in this file.
